scientific_integrity: Exact finite-state Markov-generator algebra, symbolic polynomial identities, and independent matrix-tree computations; no external validation or formal proof certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Four sites and two hard-core particles only, with positive site-departure rates (a,b,1,1). Weak-bias local Taylor response; not a general ring or thermodynamic-limit result. The existence of some nonsymmetric zero-quadratic-response examples is independently known and not claimed as novel.
title: An exact quadratic-to-quartic rectification transition in a four-site exclusion ring
